content_sections.heading: MAMC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. F.HOD/Med/Walk-in-interview/SR (Nephrology)/2026/1271 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MAMC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS with MD Medicine/DNB Medicine from recognized institution. Candidate must have valid DMC Registration at the time of interview. Other conditions: Valid DMC Registration required at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration shall be as per institute norms. Appointment on adhoc basis Tenure: 44 days Other terms and conditions as per institute norms

content_sections.heading: How Will MAMC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection by walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application Original certificates One set of attested photocopies of relevant documents Certificates in support of age, qualification and experience; case certificate Marks sheets of all professional exams, MBBS and PG degree, DMC registration certificate Two passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the walk-in interview at 11.00 AM on 25.11.2026 at the Office of Department of Medicine, 1st floor, B L Taneja Block, MAMC, New Delhi. Bring the application along with original certificates. Bring one set of attested photocopies of relevant documents. Bring two passport size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview
